Name: Shellshark
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
The shellshark is a huge subterranean predator that is a scourge on any land it calls home. They glide through the earth, bursting from it only to ambush targets and feed on them. They are fearless, vicious, and seemingly never satisfied with the prey they catch.

***Tremorhelms.*** The guardians of Greyrock’s City of Steel have domesticated shellsharks to use as mounts, fitting them with protective gear that allows a rider to safely ride them while they dig and burrow. These shellsharks are less predatory, but must be kept well fed by their owners in case they turn feral.

Stat Blocks.title: Shellshark
languages: - (if domesticated, understands Common but doesn’t speak)

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The shellshark’s long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Standing Leap
actions.description: If the shellshark jumps at least 15 feet as part of its movement, it can use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 15 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target’s choice) or be knocked prone and take 15 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 15 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn’t knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet out of the shellshark’s space into an unoccupied space of the creature’s choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the shellshark’s space.
